    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |lst| ==> (lst[i] == "(" || lst[i] == ")")
    ensures result == "Yes" || result == "No"
    ensures result == "Yes" ==> (exists i, j :: 0 <= i < |lst| && 0 <= j < |lst| && i != j && is_good(lst[i] + lst[j]))
    ensures result == "No" ==> (forall i, j :: 0 <= i < |lst| && 0 <= j < |lst| && i != j ==> !is_good(lst[i] + lst[j]))

method is_good(s: string) returns (b: bool)
    ensures b == true ==> (count_open(s) == count_close(s))
    ensures b == false ==> (count_open(s) != count_close(s) || exists k :: 0 <= k < |s| && balance_at(s, k) < 0)
